description:
Open-web pages (news, blogs, forums, stores, organizations) mentioning a brand or keyword, with a snippet; pages about the brand are tagged positive / negative / neutral. Saved as a report.

Billing: 25¢ per call — one flat fee whatever the limit. Not billed when nothing is found or the lookup fails.

When to call: what the web (not AI answers) says about the brand: press, reviews, forums, mention targets. AI answers: explore_llm_mentions.

Returns { report_id, url, keyword, mode, total_count, sample_count, relevance: {about_brand, listing, own_page, off_topic, excluded}, relevance_note (relay it), sentiment: {positive, negative, neutral}, charged_cents, mentions: [{kind, sentiment?, domain?, url?, title?, snippet?, date_published?}] (≤50, about the brand first) }. sentiment counts only kind about_brand pages (not namesakes, own pages or listings).

domain.description: The site's domain as added to AuditAE, e.g. "acme.com". Or pass site_id.

exclude_terms.description: Pages containing any are dropped, e.g. ["ebook"]. Default: the namesakes the site brief names ("not to be confused with …").

include_terms.description: A page counts as about the brand only if it contains one, e.g. ["issue tracker"]. Default: it names the site's domain, has the brand as a URL path segment, spells a mixed-case brand exactly, or names a tracked competitor or a word of the site's tracked questions.

keyword.description: The brand or keyword to look for, e.g. "Linear". Required unless mode is "domain".

limit.description: Mentions to sample, 1–1000. Default 50; the fee is flat.

mode.description: "keyword" (default) or "domain": pages naming the site's domain, for a brand name other things share.

page_type.description: Content vertical to restrict to. Omit to search all content.

site_id.description: The workspace site to save the report on (site_id from list_sites). Or pass domain.

name: explore_web_mentions
title: Scan open-web brand mentions with sentiment
